units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王的正夫人——紫姬的继母——等人说：“这妮子突然交运，立刻倒霉，可见是命苦的。

en.t: The principal wife of the Prince Minister of War, Lady Murasaki's stepmother, and the others said, "That girl suddenly came into good fortune, only to fall at once into misfortune; clearly she is ill-fated.

units.source_text: 凡是关怀她的人，母亲、外祖母、丈夫，一个个都抛弃她了。”

en.t: Everyone who cared for her, her mother, her grandmother, and her husband, has abandoned her one after another."

units.source_text: 这些话泄露出来，传到了紫姬耳中。

en.t: These words leaked out and reached Lady Murasaki's ears.

units.source_text: 她听了非常痛心，从此也绝不与娘家通问了。

en.t: When she heard them, she was deeply hurt, and from then on she never exchanged messages with her family home again.

units.source_text: 然而此外全无依靠，身世好不孤单！

en.t: Yet apart from them she had no one at all to rely on; how lonely her lot in life was!
